children: New Delhi, Sept. 7 -- Stocks such as Innovassynth, RIR Power, Pashupati Cotspin, and Zydus Wellness surged in morning deals on Monday, 7 September, amid a spurt in volume.
Innovassynth Technologies' share price hit its 52-week high and the upper circuit at Rs.142.65, with volume surging more than 10 times.
RIR Power Electronics shares surged almost 20%, with volume surging by more than 1.13 times.
Pashupati Cotspin share price surged 14% with volume surging by more than 1.69 times.
Zydus Wellness share price jumped nearly 10%, with a strong spurt in volume by more than 10.59 times.
